mechanism.summary: For an exact same-Function direct-leaf recursive call, push an independently initialized FrameState into the active Vm rather than recursively constructing a nested Vm.
mechanism.generality: The route is selected by shared Function identity and existing direct-leaf eligibility only; it does not inspect source paths, workload names, bytecode contents beyond existing eligibility, or iteration counts. Different functions retain the established direct-call route.
semantic_risks: result delivery while preserving caller operands and instruction position
throw identity plus catch and finally ordering across stacked frames
direct this and parameter-slot isolation for every recursive invocation
fallback for a dynamic direct-leaf callee that is not the active Function

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-27 /tmp/qjs-profile-controlflow-refresh.sample; 50x wrapper of the hash-verified SunSpider source
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Every same-function direct-leaf recursive call constructs a nested Vm and recursively enters Vm::run_completion.
